title: MPCG: Multi-Round Persona-Conditioned Generation for Modeling the Evolution of Misinformation with LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating the evolution of misinformation by prompting an LLM with distinct American political personas (Democrat, Republican, Moderate) and evaluating the generated claims' semantic drift, sentiment, and moral framing using MoralBERT.

Comparing GPT-4o-mini's automated evaluation ratings against human annotators on dimensions such as fluency, factuality, and role-playing consistency to identify systematic leniency or rating preferences.
